[Everything You Need][66]
* Cycles Render Engine
  
  Cycles is Blender’s built-in powerful unbiased path-tracer engine that offers stunning
  ultra-realistic rendering.
  * · Real-time viewport preview
  * · CPU & GPU rendering
  * · PBR shaders & HDR lighting support
  * · VR rendering support
  
   
* Modeling, Sculpt, UV
  
  Blender’s comprehensive array of modeling tools make creating, transforming and editing your
  models a breeze.
  * · Full N-Gon support
  * · Edge slide, inset, grid and bridge fill, and more
  * · Advanced sculpting tools and brushes
  * · Multi-resolution and Dynamic subdivision
  * · 3D painting with textured brushes and masking
  * · Python scripting for custom tools and add-ons
* VFX
  
  VFX professionals say: “Probably the best tracker in the market”. Blender includes production
  ready camera and object tracking. Allowing you to import raw footage, track the footage, mask
  areas and see the camera movements live in your 3D scene. Eliminating the need to switch between
  programs.
  * · Auto and Manual tracking
  * · Powerful camera reconstruction
  * · Real-time preview of your tracked footage and 3D scene
  * · Support for Planar tracking and Tripod solvers
* Animation & Rigging
  
  Thanks to the high quality rigging and animation tools, Blender is being used for numerous short
  films, advertisements, TV series and feature films now.
  * · Envelope, skeleton and automatic skinning
  * · B-spline interpolated bones
  * · Curve editor and dope sheets
  * · Custom bone shapes for fast input
  * · Sound synchronization
* Story Art, Drawing 2D in 3D
  
  Really! Drawing directly in a 3D viewport makes a lot of sense. It opens unsurpassed workflow
  freedom for story-boarders and 2D artists.
  * · Combine 2D with 3D right in the viewport
  * · Full Animation Support with Onion Skinning
  * · Layers & Colors for Stroke and Fill
  * · Sculpt brush strokes & Parent to 3D objects
* Make it Your Own
  
  Blender has a flexible Python controlled interface. Layout, colors, size and even fonts can be
  adjusted. Use hundreds of add-ons by the community or create your own using Blender’s accessible
  Python API.
  * · Customize the interface layout and colors
  * · Hi-res/Retina screen support
  * · Create your own tools and add-ons
  * · Draw over the OpenGL viewport
  * · Connect with Blender’s Render API

[Everything You Need][66]
* Cycles Render Engine
  
  Cycles is Blender’s built-in powerful unbiased path-tracer engine that offers stunning
  ultra-realistic rendering.
  * · Real-time viewport preview
  * · CPU & GPU rendering
  * · PBR shaders & HDR lighting support
  * · VR rendering support
  
   
* Modeling, Sculpt, UV
  
  Blender’s comprehensive array of modeling tools make creating, transforming and editing your
  models a breeze.
  * · Full N-Gon support
  * · Edge slide, inset, grid and bridge fill, and more
  * · Advanced sculpting tools and brushes
  * · Multi-resolution and Dynamic subdivision
  * · 3D painting with textured brushes and masking
  * · Python scripting for custom tools and add-ons
* VFX
  
  VFX professionals say: “Probably the best tracker in the market”. Blender includes production
  ready camera and object tracking. Allowing you to import raw footage, track the footage, mask
  areas and see the camera movements live in your 3D scene. Eliminating the need to switch between
  programs.
  * · Auto and Manual tracking
  * · Powerful camera reconstruction
  * · Real-time preview of your tracked footage and 3D scene
  * · Support for Planar tracking and Tripod solvers
* Animation & Rigging
  
  Thanks to the high quality rigging and animation tools, Blender is being used for numerous short
  films, advertisements, TV series and feature films now.
  * · Envelope, skeleton and automatic skinning
  * · B-spline interpolated bones
  * · Curve editor and dope sheets
  * · Custom bone shapes for fast input
  * · Sound synchronization
* Story Art, Drawing 2D in 3D
  
  Really! Drawing directly in a 3D viewport makes a lot of sense. It opens unsurpassed workflow
  freedom for story-boarders and 2D artists.
  * · Combine 2D with 3D right in the viewport
  * · Full Animation Support with Onion Skinning
  * · Layers & Colors for Stroke and Fill
  * · Sculpt brush strokes & Parent to 3D objects
* Make it Your Own
  
  Blender has a flexible Python controlled interface. Layout, colors, size and even fonts can be
  adjusted. Use hundreds of add-ons by the community or create your own using Blender’s accessible
  Python API.
  * · Customize the interface layout and colors
  * · Hi-res/Retina screen support
  * · Create your own tools and add-ons
  * · Draw over the OpenGL viewport
  * · Connect with Blender’s Render API

# Pencil2D Animation

## An easy, intuitive tool to make 2D hand-drawn animations.

[Download now!][15] [Tutorials][16] [What's New?][17]

## Minimal Design

Lightweight and easy to use so you can focus on animating and not what button to hit next.

## Raster & Vector

Seamlessly switch between raster and vector workflows, allowing you to sketch, ink & paint on the
go.

## Cross-Platform

Pencil2D is cross-platform and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux & FreeBSD.

## Open Source & Free

Pencil2D is completely open source and free to use, even commercially!

# Where Every Great Story Begins

[ Get Started Get Started ][26] [ Free Trial Free Trial ][27]

## Create Without Limits

The best animation studios in the world use Toon Boom software. From major animation companies to
small studios, our customers use our animation software to produce movies, TV shows, games,
explainer videos and advertisements.

Toon Boom Ember

## Focus on the creative process

Toon Boom Ember, introduced as a beta test in early spring, is now available as an add-on to users
of Storyboard Pro and Harmony. These opt-in AI tools allow professional teams to work with fewer
interruptions, iterate faster and focus on the creative process. Rather than attempt to replicate
the work which artists and animators contribute to a project, Ember's purpose is to assist. 14 day
free trial with Storyboard Pro and Harmony.

[ Learn More Learn More ][28]
Toon Boom Producer

## Every production — on time and on budget

Toon Boom Animation created Producer to offer a software solution which tracks asset creation from
start to finish, no matter where your team is located. This is a professional-grade suite of
software which replaces spreadsheets and brittle DIY solutions.

[ Get Started Get Started ][29]
Service

## YOUR GOALS. OUR EXPERTS.

We deliver precise expertise and effective solutions to meet your unique goals, leveraging a global
network of experts.

# Creating worlds of Animation

[ Get started Get started ][24] [ Try Free Try Free ][25]

# Where Every Great Story Begins

[ Get Started Get Started ][26] [ Free Trial Free Trial ][27]

## Create Without Limits

The best animation studios in the world use Toon Boom software. From major animation companies to
small studios, our customers use our animation software to produce movies, TV shows, games,
explainer videos and advertisements.

Toon Boom Ember

## Focus on the creative process

Toon Boom Ember, introduced as a beta test in early spring, is now available as an add-on to users
of Storyboard Pro and Harmony. These opt-in AI tools allow professional teams to work with fewer
interruptions, iterate faster and focus on the creative process. Rather than attempt to replicate
the work which artists and animators contribute to a project, Ember's purpose is to assist. 14 day
free trial with Storyboard Pro and Harmony.

[ Learn More Learn More ][28]
Toon Boom Producer

## Every production — on time and on budget

Toon Boom Animation created Producer to offer a software solution which tracks asset creation from
start to finish, no matter where your team is located. This is a professional-grade suite of
software which replaces spreadsheets and brittle DIY solutions.

[ Get Started Get Started ][29]

## YOUR GOALS. OUR EXPERTS.

We deliver precise expertise and effective solutions to meet your unique goals, leveraging a global
network of experts.

your logo truly stand out.
Do I need any design skills to use 3D Logo Lab?

Can I use my 3D logo on different platforms?

Is there a free trial available?

Do you store my uploaded logos or data?
[Ecommerce Webflow Template - Poppins]
No, we do not store your uploaded logos or any of your data. All files and logos are temporarily
placed on your local system while you work on them. Once you download your final 3D logo, the data
is not retained on our servers.
How is my payment information handled?

Your payment information is securely processed through Stripe, a trusted third-party payment
provider. We do not store your payment details on our servers, ensuring that your financial

# Our clients rely on us as a single, trusted partner delivering seamless, turnkey solutions
# tailored to their unique needs.

[ Call Us Today ][29]

For 15 years and counting, Abcon Automation has been a leader in the field of industrial automation.
Located in Harrison, Ohio, our work has helped clients in the tri-state Cincinnati area, and
nationwide improve their efficiency through modern and technologically advanced automation. From
control system design to PLC automation programming and panel building, we have the skills and
experience to adapt your infrastructure for optimal performance. By handling all your automation
needs, we eliminate the need to hire multiple contractors, saving you time and money. Our customers
trust us to deliver a modern, energy-efficient electrical control system that will totally transform
and optimize their operation.

[ Contact Us ][30]

## Abcon Automation Services

Here are just some of the many things that Abcon can do for your company.

### [Control & Animation][31]

Our team can build you an optimized electrical control system.

### [Installation][32]

Need a new system installed? We can install something brand new from scratch or replace your current
system.

### [Service][33]

If you need your automation system worked on, we can repair and service it as needed.

### [Programming & Interfaces][34]

We can help with programmable logic controller (PLC) programming to optimize your manufacturing
processed.

### [Panel Building][35]

We can physically assemble and wire any electrical panels your company needs.

### [VFD][36]

We can install and work on VFD and variable frequency drive systems to control motor speeds and
torques of vital pieces of equipment.

### [Case Studies & Project][37]

See some of the successful installations we have completed for companies by viewing our case
studies.

## Industries We Specialize In

### Here are some of the most common types of clients that hire us to help them with automation:
* Food and Beverage
* Pharmaceutical
* Utilities
* Waste and Fresh Water

### We are proud to have worked with large-scale global brands, such as:
* Allen Bradley
* Rockwell
* Siemens
* Mitsubishi
* Wonderware
* Modican

No matter what industry your company resides in or the scale of your project, you can trust Abcon
Automation.

[ Read More ][38]

## About Our Company

We have been counted on by companies in the tri-state Cincinnati area and beyond for over a decade.
Our ability to handle all your automation needs without the need for you to hire multiple
contractors will save you money and time. Our customers know they can trust us to deliver a modern,
energy-efficient electrical control system that will totally transform and optimize their operation.

[Electrical Set | Harrison, OH | Abcon Automation]

## Why Choose Abcon?

### 24/7 Support

If you hire us and need any support along the way, our team is available to help 24/7 so you never
have to worry.

### Timely Work

We work quickly and efficiently to make sure that your system is up and running in no time.

### 15 Years of Practical Experience

We have been working in the automation industry for over 15 years, making us one of the most
established providers of this service in the area.

### Turnkey Service

Turnkey service means that all you need to do is provide us with the documentation of what you need
and we will deliver it. We will source all the parts and do all the heavy lifting that is required
in house so you don’t need to keep calling multiple contractors to get your automation system
finished.

### A Wide Variety of Specializations

We are proud to help all kinds of companies become more efficient. Regardless of the kind of company
you have or the scale of the systems you need automated, Abcon can help.

Call today for more information about our industrial automation services. [(513) 851-7572][39]

### [VFD][36]

We can install and work on VFD and variable frequency drive systems to control motor speeds and
torques of vital pieces of equipment.

### [Case Studies & Project][37]

See some of the successful installations we have completed for companies by viewing our case
studies.

## Industries We Specialize In

### Here are some of the most common types of clients that hire us to help them with automation:
* Food and Beverage
* Pharmaceutical
* Utilities
* Waste and Fresh Water

### We are proud to have worked with large-scale global brands, such as:
* Allen Bradley
* Rockwell
* Siemens
* Mitsubishi
* Wonderware
* Modican

No matter what industry your company resides in or the scale of your project, you can trust Abcon
Automation.

[ Read More ][38]

## About Our Company

We have been counted on by companies in the tri-state Cincinnati area and beyond for over a decade.
Our ability to handle all your automation needs without the need for you to hire multiple
contractors will save you money and time. Our customers know they can trust us to deliver a modern,
energy-efficient electrical control system that will totally transform and optimize their operation.

[Electrical Set | Harrison, OH | Abcon Automation]

## Why Choose Abcon?

### 24/7 Support

If you hire us and need any support along the way, our team is available to help 24/7 so you never
have to worry.

### Timely Work

We work quickly and efficiently to make sure that your system is up and running in no time.

### 15 Years of Practical Experience

We have been working in the automation industry for over 15 years, making us one of the most
established providers of this service in the area.

### Turnkey Service

Turnkey service means that all you need to do is provide us with the documentation of what you need
and we will deliver it. We will source all the parts and do all the heavy lifting that is required
in house so you don’t need to keep calling multiple contractors to get your automation system
finished.

### A Wide Variety of Specializations

We are proud to help all kinds of companies become more efficient. Regardless of the kind of company
you have or the scale of the systems you need automated, Abcon can help.

# Frequently Asked Questions

What is Animaker?

Animaker is an online animation platform that enables anyone to create studio-quality animated
videos in minutes using a single text prompt, without prior animation or design experience.

How to use Animaker?

To create an animated video, log in to Animaker, enter your idea as a text prompt, and let the AI
generate a studio-quality animated video with animated characters, properties, and voiceovers. If
you want to refine it further, you can do it using the Advanced Edit feature. Here is a detailed
walkthrough on [how to create a video with Animaker.][74]

How much does Animaker cost?

Animaker offers a free plan for getting started with animation. In addition, Animaker offers 4
premium plans (Basic, Starter, Pro & Enterprise) with advanced features. Check out the [pricing
page][75] for more detailed info.

Is Animaker free?

Yes, Animaker is free to use. Our free plan lets you create and download animated videos with basic
animation tools, limited premium assets, and watermarked exports. In addition to the free plan,
Animaker offers 4 premium plans (Basic, Starter, Pro & Enterprise) with advanced features. Check out
the [pricing page][76] to know more in detail.

What features does Animaker offer?

Animaker offers AI-powered tools like text-to-animation, whiteboard and infographic videos, a custom
character builder, AI voiceovers, AI translation, and auto-subtitles in multiple languages—along
with 1,000+ templates, millions of stock assets, live collaboration, and 4K exports to help you
create professional animated videos in minutes.

Does Animaker support AI voiceovers?

Yes, Animaker supports AI voiceovers. It includes a built-in [AI voice generator][77] that converts
text into natural-sounding voiceovers in 180+ languages and accents with up to 99% accuracy. You can
choose from multiple AI voices, adjust tone and speed, and automatically sync narration with your
project scenes.

What types of videos can you create with Animaker?

Animaker lets you create a wide range of animated videos, including cartoon, 2D, whiteboard,
explainer, infographic, training, product demo, presentation, HR and onboarding, marketing, and
social media videos. You can also create AI avatar trainer videos and subtitle-based videos for
multilingual audiences.

How much does a 3D video production cost? Especially with 3D animated videos there is a lot of

Compared to videos shot in real life, 3D animated videos offer significant advantages:
Changeable at any time, adaptable, flexible, quickly implemented, more cost-effective and, if
necessary, everything before the actual start of series production of your products. Technical
details can also be shown that would not be visible with a real camera. Technique, zoomed in to the
depth.

## The Price Is Right - How Much Does a 3D Video Cost?

How much does a 3D video production cost? Especially with 3D animated videos there is a lot of
leeway in terms of costs. A 3D video can be produced very elaborately and impressively or simply and
inexpensively via the length, type and, above all, the level of detail. The Animations-Maschine

are always clearly discussed in advance, adhered to and always produced at a previously agreed fixed
price. Transparency is important to us. Are you looking for a 3D video production agency? With the

Do you enjoy waiting? Neither do we! That is why you will usually receive a written quotation or
initial feedback on your 3D video project on the very same day you contact us.

The actual production time naturally depends on the scope and complexity of the project. In most
cases, however, a professional 3D video production is completed within just two to three weeks.

We also respond quickly to revision requests and additional requirements throughout the production
process. Minor changes can often be completed within a few hours, while more extensive revisions are
usually finished within a few working days. This allows you to stay in full control of your project
and receive your finished 3D video on schedule, even when working with tight deadlines or short-term
requirements.

attention of new customers. In your YouTube channel, your products will be found in the second

FAQ's

## FAQ'S

### How much does video production cost?

Video production costs about as much as a car. It just depends on what kind of car you want
representing your business.


Do you need a **Ford** to quickly get you to your destination? We can help.


Do you need a **Porsche** that will turn every head in the neighborhood? We can help with that too.


### What is the turnaround?

Turnaround can vary, based on the scope of the project, but most of our projects fall in the 4-8
weeks range.


Factors that determine turnaround:
1. **Days of filming** - More shoot days, usually means more planning days too.
2. **# of deliverables** - Is it just one commercial, or an online course series with 50 videos
3. **Motion graphics or animation - **These features are time intensive
4. **Rounds of revisions **- All our project include at least 2 rounds of revisions
5. **Cooks in the kitchen** - Do revisions have to filter through several decision makers?


### Where are you based?

We are based in central Austin, Texas. We have an office and small studio off S. Lamar Blvd. Give us
a call at 512-856-5425

### Can you write a video script for me?

Absolutely! For most of our projects, we pitch concepts, write scripts and provide storyboards
(depending on budget/scope).


That is actually our favorite part of the pre-production process.

### Will you cast talent and find a location for the video?

Yes to both!


We are a turnkey production company, so we routinely handle casting talent and negotiating their
rates and terms.


We also have tons of connections with locations in the Austin areas and are happy to location scout
for your video project.

### Can you add animation & motion graphics in the video?

We love making a video more dynamic by adding animation and motion graphics.


See our [motion portfolio][45] for examples.

### Can I add photography to the package?

100%. In fact, it makes a lot of sense to shoot photography alongside video production.


All the lights are up and everyone's hair and makeup look great. Might as well grab some stills!


Check out our commercial [photography portfolio][46]

### Videographer, Cinematographer, Camera Guy - What's the difference?

A Videographer shoots weddings and events.


A Cinematographer (also known as a Director of Photography or DP) is the person running the camera
department for a film or commercial.


A Camera Guy sits behind the big camera at a baseball game. You can also hire a Camera Guy for your
kids birthday party. A Camera Guy shows up to a gig and says, "So what do you want me to shoot?"


Then what is Bennett Creative? We are a Video Production Company. That means that we do turnkey
video projects from scripting to shooting to editing. We contract some great Cinematographers for
our projects. We do occasionally do Videography for big events, long time clients, and SXSW. But we
are not Camera Guys.

### We have in-house editors. Can you just shoot video?

In most cases, we are happy to just shoot a project and let the client's marketing department handle
the editing.

### We already shot footage. Can you just edit?

We don't typically take on pure editing projects. It leaves too much to chance on the outcome. We
prefer to shoot and edit all our projects ourselves.

### What about copyright and getting the raw files?

We offer clients an unlimited license for most of our work that doesn't require talent.


As soon as hired talent is involved, there usually has to be terms and distribution limits on the
project. We can help coach you through what's best for your company.


In some cases, we also offer a RAW file buyout.

FAQ's

## FAQ'S

### How much does video production cost?

Video production costs about as much as a car. It just depends on what kind of car you want
representing your business.


Do you need a **Ford** to quickly get you to your destination? We can help.


Do you need a **Porsche** that will turn every head in the neighborhood? We can help with that too.


### What is the turnaround?

Turnaround can vary, based on the scope of the project, but most of our projects fall in the 4-8
weeks range.


Factors that determine turnaround:
1. **Days of filming** - More shoot days, usually means more planning days too.
2. **# of deliverables** - Is it just one commercial, or an online course series with 50 videos
3. **Motion graphics or animation - **These features are time intensive
4. **Rounds of revisions **- All our project include at least 2 rounds of revisions
5. **Cooks in the kitchen** - Do revisions have to filter through several decision makers?


### Where are you based?

We are based in central Austin, Texas. We have an office and small studio off S. Lamar Blvd. Give us
a call at 512-856-5425

### Can you write a video script for me?

Absolutely! For most of our projects, we pitch concepts, write scripts and provide storyboards
(depending on budget/scope).


That is actually our favorite part of the pre-production process.

### Will you cast talent and find a location for the video?

Yes to both!


We are a turnkey production company, so we routinely handle casting talent and negotiating their
rates and terms.


We also have tons of connections with locations in the Austin areas and are happy to location scout
for your video project.

### Can you add animation & motion graphics in the video?

We love making a video more dynamic by adding animation and motion graphics.


See our [motion portfolio][45] for examples.

### Can I add photography to the package?

100%. In fact, it makes a lot of sense to shoot photography alongside video production.


All the lights are up and everyone's hair and makeup look great. Might as well grab some stills!


Check out our commercial [photography portfolio][46]

### Videographer, Cinematographer, Camera Guy - What's the difference?

A Videographer shoots weddings and events.


A Cinematographer (also known as a Director of Photography or DP) is the person running the camera
department for a film or commercial.


A Camera Guy sits behind the big camera at a baseball game. You can also hire a Camera Guy for your
kids birthday party. A Camera Guy shows up to a gig and says, "So what do you want me to shoot?"


Then what is Bennett Creative? We are a Video Production Company. That means that we do turnkey
video projects from scripting to shooting to editing. We contract some great Cinematographers for
our projects. We do occasionally do Videography for big events, long time clients, and SXSW. But we
are not Camera Guys.

### We have in-house editors. Can you just shoot video?

In most cases, we are happy to just shoot a project and let the client's marketing department handle
the editing.

### We already shot footage. Can you just edit?

We don't typically take on pure editing projects. It leaves too much to chance on the outcome. We
prefer to shoot and edit all our projects ourselves.

### What about copyright and getting the raw files?

We offer clients an unlimited license for most of our work that doesn't require talent.


As soon as hired talent is involved, there usually has to be terms and distribution limits on the
project. We can help coach you through what's best for your company.


In some cases, we also offer a RAW file buyout.

### Join a global community of creators on CGconnect

###### EXPLORE. INSPIRE. GROW.

globe. Get feedback, spark conversations, and grow your visibility.

### We help creators all around the globe bring their visions to life.

###### See what our clients say about us

##### Enscape is a game changer as clients are immediately able to understand and experience our
##### vision, eliminating the subjective interpretation of sketches and the resulting
##### misunderstandings and redesign.

###### Brian Comeaux

Project Architect

##### V-Ray is rock solid, no matter what you apply it to. We've used it on everything from Thanos
##### to Terminator and we get a consistent output back every time. As we continue to push the
##### boundaries of CG characters, we need tools that can keep up. V-Ray has been there for us every
##### step of the way.

###### Bob White

Lighting Department Supervisor

##### What attracted me to Corona in the first place was its simplicity. It just felt a lot easier
##### to use than many of the other render engines I have used in the past.

###### Steven Bracki

Founder, Bracki Creative

##### Trusted by top architecture and design firms worldwide.

### Check out our latest product releases.

###### see what's new

#### One asset. Real-time to final frame.

##### V-Ray 7, update 4 for Media & Entertainment is here.
##### 
##### Access final-frame quality, real-time rendering right in your DCC’s viewport. Ensure your
##### scenes are virtual production-ready, allowing you to access real-time on LED walls in minutes
##### and take instant creative control to achieve perfect cinematic realism. Seamlessly match
##### real-world scans to your scene lighting with Gaussian Splat relighting, and reach final frames
##### faster with boosted CPU and GPU performance, artist-friendly workflows, and a renderer that’s
##### ready for any pipeline.

[Learn more][106]

###### [The 2026 V-Ray VFX & Animation Showreel is here][107]

We are proud to present this year's showreel, showcasing extraordinary work from film VFX to intense
game cinematics, feature animations, and more. This is a celebration of our community’s immense
talent and the passion brought to every production, continually pushing the boundaries of what is
possible with V-Ray. We’re honored to be part of your creative journey!

[Watch the showreel >][108]

[
][109]

###### [V-Ray 7, update 4 out now for SketchUp, Rhino, and 3ds Max][110]

V-Ray 7, Update 4 brings instant AI ideation, enhancement, image-to-video generation, and more via a
new integration with Veras. From real-time rendering in the V-Ray viewport to AI-powered tools,
enhanced realism with Quick Caustics and Parallax Interiors, and integrated collaboration—everything
works together in one proven pipeline.

[Learn more >][111]

[
][112]

###### [Veras 4.5: More control. Less friction][113]

Veras 4.5 is here, giving you finer, better control over your renders. Smart selection lets you
click any object, material, or space in your render to instantly isolate and edit it - no mask
painting. This release also adds shareable gallery links, background removal for transparent PNG
exports, upload history navigation, updated sketching tools and more.

[Learn more >][114]

###### [Corona 15: More power for artists. Same simplicity.][115]

Corona has always made stunning photoreal rendering feel simple. With Corona 15, that experience
gets even better, bringing more of what you need directly into your workflow. AI-powered ideation
with Veras is now built in, giving you the freedom to explore ideas and go from still to animation
instantly. Everything in your connected ecosystem works together more smoothly - so you can focus on
creating, collaborate easily, and deliver incredible results faster, all with full artistic control.

[Learn more >][116]

### Check out our latest product releases.

###### see what's new

#### One asset. Real-time to final frame.

##### V-Ray 7, update 4 for Media & Entertainment is here.
##### 
##### Access final-frame quality, real-time rendering right in your DCC’s viewport. Ensure your
##### scenes are virtual production-ready, allowing you to access real-time on LED walls in minutes
##### and take instant creative control to achieve perfect cinematic realism. Seamlessly match
##### real-world scans to your scene lighting with Gaussian Splat relighting, and reach final frames
##### faster with boosted CPU and GPU performance, artist-friendly workflows, and a renderer that’s
##### ready for any pipeline.

[Learn more][106]

###### [The 2026 V-Ray VFX & Animation Showreel is here][107]

We are proud to present this year's showreel, showcasing extraordinary work from film VFX to intense
game cinematics, feature animations, and more. This is a celebration of our community’s immense
talent and the passion brought to every production, continually pushing the boundaries of what is
possible with V-Ray. We’re honored to be part of your creative journey!

[Watch the showreel >][108]

[

###### [V-Ray 7, update 4 out now for SketchUp, Rhino, and 3ds Max][110]

V-Ray 7, Update 4 brings instant AI ideation, enhancement, image-to-video generation, and more via a
new integration with Veras. From real-time rendering in the V-Ray viewport to AI-powered tools,
enhanced realism with Quick Caustics and Parallax Interiors, and integrated collaboration—everything
works together in one proven pipeline.

[Learn more >][111]

[
][112]

###### [Veras 4.5: More control. Less friction][113]

Veras 4.5 is here, giving you finer, better control over your renders. Smart selection lets you
click any object, material, or space in your render to instantly isolate and edit it - no mask
painting. This release also adds shareable gallery links, background removal for transparent PNG
exports, upload history navigation, updated sketching tools and more.

[Learn more >][114]

###### [Corona 15: More power for artists. Same simplicity.][115]

Corona has always made stunning photoreal rendering feel simple. With Corona 15, that experience
gets even better, bringing more of what you need directly into your workflow. AI-powered ideation
with Veras is now built in, giving you the freedom to explore ideas and go from still to animation
instantly. Everything in your connected ecosystem works together more smoothly - so you can focus on
creating, collaborate easily, and deliver incredible results faster, all with full artistic control.

# Breakthrough StreamingBoldly built for fandom, Tubi is a free streaming service that entertains
# over 100 million monthly active users. Tubi offers the world's largest collection of Hollywood
# movies and TV shows, thousands of creator-led stories and hundreds of Tubi Originals made for the
# most passionate fans. Headquartered in San Francisco and founded in 2014, Tubi is part of Tubi
# Media Group, a division of Fox Corporation.

### Our Values

We care deeply about our culture. The five values below serve as the guiding principles for
everything we do.

##### SWING BIG

We create space to challenge the status quo. We are willing to swing and miss in order to create
exponential impact, and we celebrate the learnings that come when we fail.

##### TRUSTED PARTNER

We believe that shared context and healthy debate lead to better decisions and stronger teams. The
best partners offer feedback directly, communicate transparently, and conduct themselves with the
highest integrity and care.

##### OWN IT

We empower ourselves to identify problems and proactively bring solutions. We transcend layers,
silos, and internal roadblocks to drive progress for Tubi.

##### STAY NIMBLE

We believe that speed and agility allow us to do the impossible, so we seek velocity over
perfection. We accept that things change quickly and adapt with grace.

##### DELIVER DELIGHT

No matter our function, we treat every interaction as an opportunity to infuse a bit of Tubi magic –
we embrace this as what sets us apart.

### Coverage

Headquartered in San Francisco, Tubi is available in the US, Canada, Mexico, LATAM, United Kingdom
and Australia, and can be accessed on over 30 devices – the most of any AVOD service.

### Our Values

We care deeply about our culture. The five values below serve as the guiding principles for
everything we do.

##### SWING BIG

We create space to challenge the status quo. We are willing to swing and miss in order to create
exponential impact, and we celebrate the learnings that come when we fail.

##### TRUSTED PARTNER

We believe that shared context and healthy debate lead to better decisions and stronger teams. The
best partners offer feedback directly, communicate transparently, and conduct themselves with the
highest integrity and care.

##### OWN IT

We empower ourselves to identify problems and proactively bring solutions. We transcend layers,
silos, and internal roadblocks to drive progress for Tubi.

##### STAY NIMBLE

We believe that speed and agility allow us to do the impossible, so we seek velocity over
perfection. We accept that things change quickly and adapt with grace.

##### DELIVER DELIGHT

No matter our function, we treat every interaction as an opportunity to infuse a bit of Tubi magic –
we embrace this as what sets us apart.

# about daonline

starting from the age of 9 years old, founder will ryan created diamond armada which started as an
animation channel on newgrounds. since then, it has grown into an ecosystem that fosters original
stories, music, comics and a new video game. bolstering over 2 million subscribers and 100 billion
overall views, he made his successes through dagames’s nerdcore material, particularly focusing on
subjects like fnaf, bendy, hello neighbor and cuphead, just to name a few. for the last 11 years of
professional spotlight, they have a plethora of gameplay videos, personalities and even taken their
music on the road across the uk and many states of america.

# dagames

with over 2 million subscriber and 11 long professional years of experience, dagames has made a name
for themselves in the nerdcore scene, smashing out several iconic projects since beginning. with a
few videos already reaching 100 million views and bolstering billions of overall views, dagames is a
driving force for the music scene that has inspired many to pursue their own endeavours.

alongside the music, they play games too! from solo personality content all the way through several
personalities butting heads in their series daknockout, their personality shines through and has
amassed a large following already!

with two passion projects under the belt, flashdrive and open infinitum, they have surely expanded
the bounds of normalcy, all to show that there is never one way of creating material, which has
inspired many more to follow suit and express themselves in the online world of media.

# iris

hither & yonder. be ready for wonder.

IRIS is a large dystopian sci-fi centered around a noble warrior on a mission to restore the galaxy
and bring back truth to a world that had lost its way by retrieving the all seeing and all knowing
emblem made from deities, the iris. with seven planets at danger of being consumed by the quickly
sinking bubble of space, the damned, goliath will endure tenacity beyond his limit and facing off
against many on his one and only mission.

iris started out as an original musical project by will ryan, which quickly turned into a three
album armageddon, sporting an intensely dedicated community and a larger and life lore. what once
used to be a one man army has turned into an entire team of passionate individuals who are bringing
their a-game to this fantasy universe.

# pandorium

since the world of iris was created, original stories were saught after more and more. pandorium was
born as a three story anthology series, with its biggest of those stories being solitude, already
with music, a loveable set of characters, a dense lore, and even a game.

alongside this are the other two in progress stories, mercy’s garden and humn.

## Subscribe FOR UPDATES

Sign up with your email address to receive news and updates.

Hooray!

overall views, he made his successes through dagames’s nerdcore material, particularly focusing on
subjects like fnaf, bendy, hello neighbor and cuphead, just to name a few. for the last 11 years of
professional spotlight, they have a plethora of gameplay videos, personalities and even taken their
music on the road across the uk and many states of america.

# dagames

with over 2 million subscriber and 11 long professional years of experience, dagames has made a name
for themselves in the nerdcore scene, smashing out several iconic projects since beginning. with a
few videos already reaching 100 million views and bolstering billions of overall views, dagames is a
driving force for the music scene that has inspired many to pursue their own endeavours.

alongside the music, they play games too! from solo personality content all the way through several
personalities butting heads in their series daknockout, their personality shines through and has
amassed a large following already!

with two passion projects under the belt, flashdrive and open infinitum, they have surely expanded
the bounds of normalcy, all to show that there is never one way of creating material, which has
inspired many more to follow suit and express themselves in the online world of media.

# iris

hither & yonder. be ready for wonder.

IRIS is a large dystopian sci-fi centered around a noble warrior on a mission to restore the galaxy
and bring back truth to a world that had lost its way by retrieving the all seeing and all knowing
emblem made from deities, the iris. with seven planets at danger of being consumed by the quickly
sinking bubble of space, the damned, goliath will endure tenacity beyond his limit and facing off
against many on his one and only mission.

iris started out as an original musical project by will ryan, which quickly turned into a three
album armageddon, sporting an intensely dedicated community and a larger and life lore. what once
used to be a one man army has turned into an entire team of passionate individuals who are bringing
their a-game to this fantasy universe.

# pandorium

since the world of iris was created, original stories were saught after more and more. pandorium was
born as a three story anthology series, with its biggest of those stories being solitude, already
with music, a loveable set of characters, a dense lore, and even a game.

alongside this are the other two in progress stories, mercy’s garden and humn.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What can I do with DomoAI?

DomoAI offers AI-powered tools including AI video and image generation, plus advanced editing
features like lip sync for a seamless workflow. Perfect for all levels of creators - from small
content creators to professional studios who need high-quality visuals quickly.

Is DomoAI free to use?

Yes! DomoAI offers a free plan with credits to get you started. You can create AI videos and images
without any upfront cost. We also offer paid subscription plans with more credits and advanced
features for heavy users and professional creators. For more details, please visit the [Pricing
page][104].

Can I use the content generated commercially?

Absolutely! All content you create with DomoAI can be used for commercial purposes, including [AI
animation][105], marketing videos, social media content, advertisements, and client projects. You
own the rights to your generated content and can monetize it freely.

Is my uploaded content secure?

Yes, your data security is our priority. All uploaded files are encrypted and processed securely. We
don't share, sell, or use your content for any purpose other than generating your requested output.
Your original files and generated content remain private to your account. For more information,
please visit [privacy policy][106].

I have more questions. How can I reach out?

Join our Discord community with 5M+ Creators at [https://discord.gg/domoai][107] for instant support
and tips. You can also contact our support team by email us at [[email protected]][108] directly.
Our community and team are always ready to help you create amazing content!

At DreamingFish, one of our core values is ‘We Care’.

and mentoring. We also support the **[MAP Charity][77]** in their mission to help young people in
